collection.name: Software & Bots
collection.description: Application runtimes, Discord bots, APIs and microservices
collection.author: Midnight Team

shard.name: Node.js
shard.description: General-purpose Node.js environment supporting Git auto-pull, npm dependency installation, and JavaScript/TypeScript Discord bots and web services.
shard.author: Midnight Team
shard.startupCommand: if [[ -d .git ]] && [[ "{{GIT_AUTO_UPDATE}}" == "1" ]]; then git pull; fi; if [[ ! -d node_modules ]] || [[ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" == "1" ]]; then npm install --production=false; fi; node {{MAIN_FILE}} {{ADDITIONAL_ARGS}}
shard.installScript:
#!/bin/bash
# Node.js Application Installation Script for Midnight Panel
set -e
apk add --no-cache git curl ca-certificates

cd /mnt/server

if [ ! -z "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
    echo "Cloning git repository: ${GIT_ADDRESS}..."
    if [ -z "${GIT_BRANCH}" ]; then
        GIT_BRANCH="main"
    fi
    git clone -b ${GIT_BRANCH} ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
fi

if [ -f "package.json" ]; then
    echo "Found package.json, installing dependencies..."
    npm install --production=false
fi

echo "Node.js application installation completed!"

variables.name: Main Executable File
variables.description: The entrypoint JavaScript file to run with Node (e.g. index.js, app.js, bot.js, dist/index.js).

variables.name: Auto Update Dependencies
variables.description: Automatically run 'npm install' every time the server starts up (1 = yes, 0 = no).

variables.name: Git Auto Pull
variables.description: Automatically run 'git pull' on server boot if a git repo is initialized (1 = yes, 0 = no).

variables.name: Git Clone Address
variables.description: Optional Git repository URL to clone upon server creation (e.g. https://github.com/user/mybot.git).

variables.name: Additional Arguments
variables.description: Extra arguments appended to the node command.
